message.content: Starting triage on the reported force-limit breach — shrinking to the minimal repro.
Shrink isolated a one-body case. Replaying to confirm the violation before digging in.
Replay confirms the failure. Now inspecting the violating state and its run-up.
Violation state captured. Checking earlier steps to trace the force buildup.
Force looked clamped two steps earlier — checking the step right before the breach.
The clamp held until the final step — now sampling earlier states to map the pattern.
I see clamping held at steps 130-131 but broke at 132 — probing the force history to characterize the pattern.
Force was clamped early but broke through only on the final step — checking the full violation list to confirm scope.
Only the final step violates while earlier steps stay clamped — testing a raised force limit as the counterfactual.
The limit raise still breached — trying a high ceiling to establish a clean counterfactual.
Raising only fmax to 200 removes the violation, supporting a clamping failure. Gathering one more data point on the mechanism.
The clamp mostly holds but intermittently lets raw demand through — testing a reduced-gain counterfactual to confirm.
Lowering the gain clears the violation, confirming the clamp mechanism. Gathering final evidence to file the report.
